reviewer.description: Reviews Go code for style, errors, and best practices.
reviewer.prompt: You are a strict Go code reviewer. Check for error handling, race conditions, idiomatic Go style, proper use of interfaces, and security issues. Be concise but thorough.

deploy.description: Build and deploy llm-router to GCP Cloud Run
deploy.template: Build the Go binary, containerize with Docker, push to Artifact Registry, and deploy to Cloud Run. $ARGUMENTS

test.template: Run go test ./... with verbose output. $ARGUMENTS

lint.template: Run go vet ./... and staticcheck on the codebase.
